_comment: Per-field value guide (generated by scripts/build_value_guide.py from schema.json). Tells a filler what each field should contain, with formats, address components, calculations to validate, and adversarial values to avoid. Not legal advice.

county.label: County
county.expects: a Maine county name (the form prints 'COUNTY'/'Probate Court'); rendered upper-case, without the word 'County'

docket_no.label: Docket No
avoid: a docket from another jurisdiction's format

individual_name.label: Individual Name
individual_name.expects: full legal name as it should appear on the order
avoid: 'Last, First' order unless the line calls for it

claimant_name.label: Claimant Name
claimant_name.expects: full legal name as it should appear on the order
avoid: 'Last, First' order unless the line calls for it

claimant_address.label: Claimant Address
claimant_address.expects: an address with: street, city, state, zip
avoid: the state spelled out ('Maine') when an abbreviation fits
a PO box where a physical/legal residence is required

basis_for_claim.label: Basis For Claim
basis_for_claim.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

amount_claimed.label: Amount Claimed
amount_claimed.expects: a dollar amount, digits and decimal point only
avoid: a '$' character inside the value (the form prints it)
a negative amount unless this line is explicitly a credit

nature_of_uncertainty.label: Nature Of Uncertainty
nature_of_uncertainty.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

security_for_claim.label: Security For Claim
security_for_claim.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

claimant_date.label: Claimant Date
avoid: a value that runs across a printed comma or '20__' stub — those are separate day/month/year fields

claimant_attorney_name.label: Claimant Attorney Name
claimant_attorney_name.expects: full legal name as it should appear on the order
avoid: 'Last, First' order unless the line calls for it

claimant_attorney_address.label: Claimant Attorney Address
claimant_attorney_address.expects: an address with: street, city, state, zip
avoid: the state spelled out ('Maine') when an abbreviation fits
a PO box where a physical/legal residence is required

decision_status.label: Decision Status
decision_status.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

partial_amount.label: Partial Amount
partial_amount.expects: a dollar amount, digits and decimal point only
avoid: a '$' character inside the value (the form prints it)
a negative amount unless this line is explicitly a credit

notice_mailed_date.label: Notice Mailed Date
avoid: a value that runs across a printed comma or '20__' stub — those are separate day/month/year fields

conservator_date.label: Conservator Date
avoid: a value that runs across a printed comma or '20__' stub — those are separate day/month/year fields

conservator_attorney_name.label: Conservator Attorney Name
conservator_attorney_name.expects: full legal name as it should appear on the order
avoid: 'Last, First' order unless the line calls for it

conservator_attorney_address.label: Conservator Attorney Address

avoid: the state spelled out ('Maine') when an abbreviation fits
a PO box where a physical/legal residence is required
